system.description: Touching a device or data container and spending a Willpower Trait, you then spend Mental Traits to mystically scramble its controls or data so only you can use it; each level of Computer Ability you possess counts as two Traits toward this total. Others must win a Static Mental Challenge against the Traits spent to bypass it, and those lacking relevant skills cannot even attempt it. The same process in reverse decrypts a target, and the effect lasts for weeks equal to your permanent Willpower Traits.
system.duration: Weeks equal to permanent Willpower Traits
